title.value: Take All Menstrual Product-PFAS Out Now (T.A.M.P.O.N.) Act
title.provenance: AB 2515, Papan. Menstrual products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

pfas_definition.provenance: Regulated PFAS means the following: (1) Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product...

type.provenance: 25258.3. A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

who.provenance: 25258.4. (a) On or before July 1, 2029, a manufacturer of a menstrual product, as defined in this article, shall register with the department...

action.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS.

products.provenance: 25258. definition of 'Menstrual product' includes tampons, pads, sponges, menstruation underwear, disks, and menstrual cups

value: sale or resale of a used product
exceptions.provenance: The bill would not apply to: (1) a product for which federal law governs the presence of PFAS in the product in a manner that preempts state authority; (2) a product regulated under section 325F.072 or 325F.075; or (3) the sale or resale of a used product.

intentionally_added.provenance: 25258.1. On or before January 1, 2027, the department shall adopt regulations to implement, interpret, enforce, or make specific this article.
